article.title: What are the pros and cons of Go compared to Java and .NET when developing a REST API?
article.quote: In software development, simplicity is not a luxury, but a prerequisite for scalability.
article.alinea1: In a landscape dominated by cloud-native microservices, startup times and memory usage are increasingly determining a project’s architectural success.
article.alinea2: Go stands out for its lightweight binaries and minimal memory footprint, while Java and .NET boast decades of maturity, extensive libraries, and advanced JIT optimizations.
article.alinea3: By replacing complex abstractions with powerful “goroutines” and a minimalist syntax, Go enables developers to build high-performance systems that are easier to maintain and cheaper to host than traditional enterprise stacks.
